data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's proposal (co-constructing witnesses during iteration) and SRC_002's proposal (materializing reinstatement edges with warrants) both require the final DefenseWitness to record edges that may be invalidated in later rounds. SRC_003 addresses determinism of the witness by fixing a total order or emitting the full accepted-defender set, but neither canonicalization handles the semantic non-uniqueness that the other proposals introduce: the full accepted-defender set at the final fixed point may still include defenders whose own warrants were defeated in earlier rounds, and a total order over such a set does not make the witness semantically correct. SRC_003's repair targets order-dependence but assumes the accepted-defender set is already the correct witness content; under the modified constructions the set itself may be inconsistent with the label fixed point, so the emitted canonical witness can be unique yet wrong, failing the committed-root validity guarantee.
